title: Plan the Week smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Plan the Week craftbook: the week's eight events come from the owner's synced Google Calendar in the artifacts drawer, and tasks/eval/report.md shapes the days with the agenda-less meetings flagged for prep, the Tuesday conflict named, and focus blocks defended.
prompt: monday again — can you lay out a plan for the week in tasks/eval/report.md? my calender is synced into the project and my open followups are in the workspace

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for week-plan. The owner's Google Calendar is connected and synced: one record per event under data/google-calendar/ in the artifacts drawer. Open follow-ups are seeded at followups.json; the deliverable is tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Plan the Week craftbook/template, read the week's events from the synced calendar records, fold in the open follow-ups, and write tasks/eval/report.md. No real services, credentials, or live calendars.

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: Every event from the calendar week appears in the plan; nothing is silently dropped and nothing is invented.

axes.name: prioritization
axes.description: Focus blocks land in real gaps, the biggest work gets the biggest gap, and follow-ups sit on days with room.

axes.name: conflict-handling
axes.description: The overlapping pair is named with a concrete proposed fix the owner can accept in one decision.

axes.name: realism
axes.description: The load picture is honest — heavy days are called heavy, and no day is over-packed to look tidy.
